name: CookieShift – Cookie Consent Banner & Compliance Manager
author: cookieshift

sections.description:
Smarter Cookie Consent for WordPress

CookieShift is a Cookie Consent Management Platform (CMP) for websites that want a clearer way to manage cookies, tracking technologies, visitor consent, and privacy preferences.

The CookieShift WordPress plugin connects your website to the CookieShift platform. Once connected, CookieShift can display a customizable cookie consent banner and preference center while the CookieShift dashboard provides tools for scanning cookies, managing consent categories, configuring supported tracking behavior, reviewing consent activity, and managing privacy-related settings.

CookieShift brings cookie discovery, consent management, banner customization, multilingual tools, consent analytics, and AI-assisted privacy workflows into one connected experience.

It is designed to help website owners understand what is running on their website and give visitors meaningful control over their privacy choices.

Key Features

  • Cookie Consent Banner — Give visitors clear consent choices.
  • Preference Center — Let visitors review and update privacy preferences.
  • Cookie & Tracker Scanner — Discover cookies, trackers, scripts, and other technologies.
  • Consent Management — Organize technologies into configurable consent categories.
  • Supported Tracking Control — Use consent preferences to control supported non-essential tracking.
  • Consent Analytics — Review available consent activity and website information.
  • Multilingual Tools — Manage consent experiences for different languages.
  • AI-Assisted Privacy Workflows — Get assistance with classification, descriptions, consent content, privacy analysis, and translations.
  • Google Consent Mode — Configure CookieShift to communicate consent signals to supported Google services.

How CookieShift Works

CookieShift connects your WordPress website with the hosted CookieShift platform.

After installing the plugin:

  1. Create a new CookieShift account or connect an existing account.
  2. Connect your WordPress website to a CookieShift Site ID.
  3. Scan your website for cookies and tracking technologies.
  4. Review and classify the technologies discovered.
  5. Configure consent categories and privacy preferences.
  6. Customize your cookie banner and preference center.
  7. Configure supported tracking and script behavior.
  8. Publish your consent configuration.
  9. Monitor consent activity and scan information from the CookieShift dashboard.

The WordPress plugin provides the WordPress integration and loads the CookieShift CMP. Cookie scanning, dashboard functionality, analytics, AI-assisted tools, and other hosted services are provided by the CookieShift platform.

Cookie Consent Banner

CookieShift provides a customizable cookie consent banner that helps visitors understand and manage their privacy choices.

Depending on the configuration, visitors can accept cookies and tracking technologies, reject non-essential cookies, customize consent preferences, choose individual consent categories, open the preference center, and change their preferences later.

Administrators can manage banner content, buttons, categories, languages, appearance, preference-center settings, and consent behavior from the CookieShift platform.

Cookie Preference Center

The CookieShift preference center gives visitors more control over their privacy choices.

Administrators can organize cookies and tracking technologies into categories such as Necessary, Preferences, Analytics, Marketing, Advertising, and other non-essential technologies.

Visitors can review available categories and update their preferences according to the configuration published by the website administrator.

Cookie & Tracker Scanner

CookieShift includes a hosted scanner that helps discover cookies, trackers, scripts, and other technologies used by your website.

The scanner can help you:

  • Discover cookies and tracking technologies.
  • Build a cookie and technology inventory.
  • Find previously unknown technologies.
  • Identify unclassified cookies.
  • Review cookie purposes and classifications.
  • Organize technologies into consent categories.
  • Review changes found during later scans.

Scanning is provided by the CookieShift hosted service rather than being performed entirely inside the WordPress plugin.

Cookie & Script Control

CookieShift can use visitor consent preferences to control supported non-essential tracking technologies.

This can help website administrators manage technologies such as analytics, marketing, advertising, and other non-essential tracking according to the visitor’s consent state.

Actual enforcement can depend on how individual scripts and tags are implemented, browser behavior, and tag loading order. Review the implementation guidance provided in your CookieShift dashboard when configuring tracking technologies.

Consent Management

CookieShift provides tools for managing the consent workflow.

Administrators can configure:

  • Consent categories.
  • Accept and reject behavior.
  • Preference center options.
  • Banner content.
  • Banner buttons.
  • Cookie and tracker classifications.
  • Supported tracking behavior.
  • Languages.
  • Consent preferences.

Configuration is managed through CookieShift, so normal banner changes do not require editing WordPress theme files.

Google Consent Mode

CookieShift can be configured to work with Google Consent Mode and communicate visitor consent signals to supported Google services.

The final behavior depends on your Google tag configuration, CookieShift settings, and how Google services are implemented on your website.

Always verify your tag implementation and consent configuration before publishing changes.

Multilingual Consent

CookieShift supports multilingual consent experiences for websites serving visitors in different languages and regions.

Administrators can manage consent-related content for different languages through the CookieShift platform.

CookieShift also provides AI-assisted translation capabilities that can help generate translation content for review before publishing.

Translated content should always be reviewed before being shown to visitors.

AI-Assisted Privacy Management

CookieShift includes AI-assisted tools to simplify repetitive cookie and privacy-management tasks.

Depending on your plan and configuration, AI assistance can help with:

  • Cookie and tracker classification.
  • Cookie category suggestions.
  • Cookie descriptions.
  • Consent-related content.
  • Privacy analysis.
  • Translation workflows.

AI-generated results are assistance only. They should be reviewed before publishing and do not certify GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, ePrivacy, or any other legal requirement.

Privacy & Compliance Support

CookieShift provides technical tools that can help websites manage consent workflows associated with:

  • GDPR.
  • CCPA and related US privacy requirements.
  • LGPD.
  • ePrivacy.

CookieShift helps website owners provide privacy choices, manage visitor consent, and control supported non-essential tracking according to their configuration.

Privacy requirements vary depending on location, business activities, data processing practices, technologies, third-party services, and applicable laws.

CookieShift does not guarantee legal compliance. Installing the plugin alone does not make a website legally compliant.

Website owners remain responsible for their privacy notices, cookie policies, consent configuration, tracking implementation, and applicable legal requirements.

Supported Platforms

CookieShift is designed to work across multiple website platforms and technologies.

Available integrations and implementation options include:

  • WordPress.
  • WooCommerce.
  • Joomla.
  • Shopify.
  • PrestaShop.
  • Wix.
  • React.
  • Custom websites through the CookieShift API.

The CookieShift WordPress plugin provides the WordPress integration while the CookieShift platform provides centralized consent management and privacy tools.

CookieShift Dashboard

The CookieShift dashboard provides the central management area for connected websites.

Depending on your plan and configuration, you can access:

  • Website management.
  • Cookie scanning.
  • Cookie and tracker inventory.
  • Consent categories.
  • Banner customization.
  • Preference center configuration.
  • Consent activity and analytics.
  • Compliance-related information.
  • AI-assisted privacy tools.
  • Translation tools.
  • Integration health.
  • Reports and privacy tools.

Free Plan

CookieShift provides a Free plan so website owners can get started without requiring a paid subscription.

Available features and limits depend on the selected CookieShift plan and can include limits for websites, scans, AI usage, and other platform capabilities.

For current plan information, visit:
https://cookieshift.com/pricing/

What the WordPress Plugin Does

The CookieShift WordPress plugin provides the connection between WordPress and the CookieShift platform.

The plugin:

  • Loads the CookieShift CMP on the public website when connected.
  • Allows administrators to create a CookieShift account.
  • Allows administrators to connect an existing CookieShift account.
  • Connects the website to a CookieShift Site ID.
  • Provides access to CookieShift dashboard tools.
  • Shows available consent activity summaries in WordPress admin.
  • Provides synchronization and connection management.
  • Allows administrators to disconnect the website.
  • Stores the Site ID required for the integration.
  • Stores an encrypted API/module token for authenticated server-side communication.

Advanced scanning, analytics, AI-assisted functionality, and hosted CMP services are provided by the CookieShift platform.

Configuration

After connecting your website:

  1. Open the CookieShift dashboard.
  2. Run a website scan.
  3. Review discovered cookies and tracking technologies.
  4. Classify and organize technologies into consent categories.
  5. Configure your consent preferences.
  6. Customize the cookie banner and preference center.
  7. Configure supported tracking behavior.
  8. Publish your configuration.
  9. Test the banner and preference center on your website.

Managing the Connection

The WordPress admin integration allows administrators to:

  • Create a new CookieShift account.
  • Connect an existing CookieShift account.
  • Connect the current website.
  • Synchronize module status.
  • View available consent information.
  • Open CookieShift dashboard tools.
  • Disconnect the website.

Disconnecting removes the locally stored API token. The CookieShift cloud account and website property are not deleted.

The Site ID may be retained so the website can be reconnected to the same CookieShift property when possible.

Privacy / Data Handling

When connected, the plugin can store:

  • CookieShift Site ID.
  • Encrypted API/module token.
  • Site URL or installation identity.
  • Optional workspace metadata.

The API/module token is stored in WordPress options using encrypted storage based on site salts.

The token is used for server-side communication with CookieShift and is not intentionally exposed on public website pages.

The hosted CookieShift CMP can process consent decisions according to the configuration associated with your CookieShift website.

Uninstalling the plugin removes its stored CookieShift options from the WordPress database.

External Services

This plugin connects to the CookieShift service.

Service: https://cookieshift.com/

Terms of Service: https://cookieshift.com/terms-and-conditions

Privacy Policy: https://cookieshift.com/legal/privacy

The service is used for:

  • Consent banner and CMP delivery.
  • Consent configuration.
  • Cookie and tracker scanning.
  • Consent activity and analytics.
  • Module and integration health.
  • AI-assisted privacy functionality.
  • Translation functionality.
  • Synchronization between WordPress and CookieShift.

Information transmitted may include the CookieShift Site ID, server-side authentication information, website installation information, consent-related data handled by the hosted CMP, and cookie or script metadata when scanning and AI features are used.

The connection can occur when the website is connected, when administrators use synchronization or dashboard features, when health checks are performed, and when visitors load pages containing the CookieShift CMP.

The CookieShift service may use endpoints including:

https://cookieshift.com/cmp.js
https://cookieshift.com/banner.js
https://cookieshift.com/api/

The exact endpoints may change as the CookieShift service evolves.

The plugin does not intentionally include unrelated advertising pixels, referral trackers, or third-party CDNs.

Support

Documentation: https://cookieshift.com/docs?utm_source=wordpress&utm_medium=plugin&utm_campaign=wordpress_page&utm_content=documentation

Help Center: https://cookieshift.com/help?utm_source=wordpress&utm_medium=plugin&utm_campaign=wordpress_page&utm_content=help

Website: https://cookieshift.com/?utm_source=wordpress&utm_medium=plugin&utm_campaign=wordpress_page&utm_content=website

Terms of Service: https://cookieshift.com/terms-and-conditions?utm_source=wordpress&utm_medium=plugin&utm_campaign=wordpress_page&utm_content=terms

Privacy Policy: https://cookieshift.com/legal/privacy?utm_source=wordpress&utm_medium=plugin&utm_campaign=wordpress_page&utm_content=privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install CookieShift from Plugins → Add New, or upload the plugin ZIP.
  2. Activate CookieShift – Cookie Consent Banner & Compliance Manager.
  3. Open CookieShift from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Select Create New CookieShift Account or Connect Existing Account.
  5. Complete the CookieShift connection flow.
  6. Connect your website to a CookieShift Site ID.
  7. Configure your consent experience from the CookieShift dashboard.
  8. Visit your website and verify that the cookie banner is displayed.
sections.faq:
What is CookieShift?

CookieShift is a Cookie Consent Management Platform that helps websites discover cookies and trackers, manage visitor consent, control supported non-essential tracking, and review consent activity.

Is CookieShift more than a cookie banner?

Yes. CookieShift combines a consent banner and preference center with cookie scanning, cookie classification, consent management, supported tracking control, analytics, multilingual tools, and AI-assisted privacy workflows.

Does CookieShift require an account?

Yes. A CookieShift account and Site ID are required to connect the WordPress plugin to the CookieShift platform.

Can I create an account from WordPress?

Yes. Select Create New CookieShift Account from the CookieShift WordPress admin page and complete the connection flow.

Can I connect an existing CookieShift account?

Yes. Select Connect Existing Account and complete the existing account connection flow.

Does CookieShift scan my website?

Yes. CookieShift provides a hosted scanner that can discover cookies, trackers, scripts, and other technologies used by your website.

Can CookieShift automatically categorize cookies?

CookieShift can provide classification assistance, including AI-assisted suggestions depending on your plan and configuration. Review classifications before publishing.

Can CookieShift block cookies and scripts?

CookieShift provides consent-based control for supported non-essential tracking technologies. Enforcement can depend on script implementation, browser behavior, and tag loading order.

Can I customize the cookie banner?

Yes. Banner content, appearance, buttons, categories, languages, and preference-center settings can be configured through CookieShift.

Does CookieShift support Google Consent Mode?

Yes. CookieShift can communicate consent signals to supported Google services through Google Consent Mode when correctly configured.

Does CookieShift support GDPR and CCPA?

CookieShift provides tools for consent workflows associated with GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, ePrivacy, and related privacy requirements.

CookieShift does not provide legal advice or guarantee legal compliance.

Does CookieShift support multiple languages?

Yes. CookieShift supports multilingual consent experiences and AI-assisted translation workflows.

Does CookieShift use AI?

Yes. Depending on your plan and configuration, AI can assist with cookie classification, descriptions, privacy tasks, consent content, and translations.

Does AI guarantee compliance?

No. AI-generated results are assistance only and must be reviewed before publishing.

Is CookieShift free?

CookieShift offers a Free plan. Features and usage limits depend on the selected plan.

Does scanning run inside WordPress?

No. Cookie scanning is provided by the CookieShift hosted platform.

Does the plugin send information to CookieShift?

Yes. The plugin communicates with CookieShift for CMP delivery, configuration, synchronization, analytics, health checks, and other available functionality.

See the External Services section for details.

What happens when I disconnect the plugin?

The locally stored API token is removed. Your CookieShift cloud account and website property are not deleted.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

The plugin removes its stored CookieShift options from the WordPress database.

Does installing CookieShift make my website legally compliant?

No. CookieShift provides technical consent-management tools. Website owners remain responsible for their privacy policies, configuration, implementation, and applicable legal requirements.

Does CookieShift work with other platforms?

Yes. CookieShift provides integrations and implementation options for WordPress, WooCommerce, Joomla, Shopify, PrestaShop, Wix, React, and custom websites through its API.
